definitions.explanation: A musical performance by a single singer, typically in classical or formal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦オペラ→オペラ：28763_opera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{独唱|どくしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしかった→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{独唱|どくしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金賞|きんしょう}→金賞：21052_kinshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: She won the gold award for her solo.

examples.japanese: {独唱|どくしょう}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。

notes:
Compound of ⟦{独|どく}→独：noentry⟧ (alone) + ⟦{唱|しょう}→唱：noentry⟧ (sing). Refers specifically to a vocal solo — one singer performing alone, typically in classical music, opera, or formal concert settings.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {独唱|どくしょう}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: solo recital
- {独唱|どくしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to sing a solo
- {独唱|どくしょう}⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧: solo piece

RELATED MUSICAL TERMS:
- ⟦{独奏|どくそう}→独奏：07539_dokusou⟧: instrumental solo (same structure with ⟦{奏|そう}→奏：noentry⟧ = play)
- ⟦{合唱|がっしょう}→合唱：04900_gasshou⟧: chorus, choir singing
- ⟦{重唱|じゅうしょう}→重唱：28764_juushou⟧: vocal ensemble (duet, trio, quartet)
- ⟦ソロ→ソロ：11026_soro⟧: solo (casual loanword, used in all genres)

{独唱|どくしょう} sounds formal and classical. In pop or casual contexts, ⟦ソロ→ソロ：11026_soro⟧ is preferred.
